build_step3vl_processor: build a Step3VLProcessor instance with a config and tokenizer for multimodal image-text model input
create_image_patcher: create an ImagePatcher to split images into sliding windows and extract patches for vision processing
run_step3_vision_processor: run a Step3VisionProcessor to normalize, resize, and convert images to normalized pixel value tensors
test_gpu_to_tensor: test the GPUToTensor module to convert PIL images or numpy arrays to GPU tensors
process_mm_data_async: process multimodal data asynchronously with Step3VLImageProcessor returning token IDs and mm items
